subject: maths
question:
Study the given graph and answer the question that follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6a623a46f76d309b77d88ab97510a11960f923822738eed9400e478bb92939b.png] 

The average production of fertilisers by country Z in 2017, 2018 and 2020 is what percentage more than the average production of fertilisers by country X in 2018 and 2020?
solution:
**Calculation:**

The average production of fertilisers by country Z in 2017, 2018 and 2020 = ((330 + 360 + 420)/({3)})

⇒ (1110)/({3)}

⇒ 370

The average production of fertilisers by country X in 2018 and 2020 = ((240 + 260)/({2)})

⇒ (500)/({2)}

⇒ 250

Required percentage = ((370 - 250))/({250)} × 100

⇒ (120)/({250)} × 100

⇒ (24 × 2)%

⇒ 48%

**∴ The required average production is 48%**
